ux_source: User-supplied GUIDED-MISSION-UX0 DESIGN_FROZEN text, 2026-09-23; implementation and acceptance NOT STARTED

classification_meaning.REUSE: Existing production capability or read projection can be used unchanged.
classification_meaning.HOOK: Add a narrow integration point to an existing surface or read path.
classification_meaning.SMALL_CHANGE: Bounded product presentation or adapter change; no authority semantics change.
classification_meaning.NEW: Tutorial-owned contract, state, isolation, or witness packaging not present in v0.1.0.
classification_meaning.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Explicitly excluded from first-run A/B/C implementation.

requirements.requirement: First-run entry, later Help entry, pause/resume/restart/skip (TUX14)
requirements.existing_implementation: Routes exist but no first-run or Help mission entry; App only renders RouterView.
requirements.required_change: One route-independent Mission host and tutorial-only session controls; keep Open Repository and Explore independently available.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Entry or skip must not publish evidence or imply completion.
requirements.test_requirement: Fresh-user browser entry, exit, restart and keyboard-only control tests.

requirements.requirement: Reuse Explorer, Canvas, Inspector and Dock; no second tutorial product (TUX1)
requirements.existing_implementation: Normal workbench already composes four surfaces; /topology is a second existing workbench shell and /changes/:id is a separate Change Workspace.
requirements.required_change: Mount mission presentation across existing routes; do not duplicate a new Explorer/Canvas/Inspector/Dock.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: A visual overlay must not synthesize evidence.
requirements.test_requirement: Route traversal retains normal workbench capabilities and no separate tutorial graph appears.

requirements.requirement: Persistent compact Mission Strip with semantic milestones, hint, pause and exit; no percentage
requirements.existing_implementation: TopBar has brand, repository, snapshot, index, topology, Design Changes, language/theme/search; no free 1280px slot.
requirements.required_change: Add route-level compact strip outside the existing horizontal TopBar; use semantic milestone labels, never percent.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Milestone rendering consumes backend MissionState only.
requirements.test_requirement: 1280/1440/1800 layout, keyboard, no color-only status and no local completion state.

requirements.requirement: Mission Drawer with why/objective/success/hints/explain/restart/exit
requirements.existing_implementation: Workbench already has 300px Explorer and 360px Inspector; Change Workspace uses 220px nav and optional 330px Inspector.
requirements.required_change: Use dismissible overlay or responsive transient region, not a permanent additional grid column; preserve focus and close/escape behavior.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Drawer explanations must show source limitations and cannot rename backend states.
requirements.test_requirement: Viewport geometry plus focus trap/return and non-obscured main controls.

requirements.requirement: At most one optional Context Cue after hint request or bounded stall (TUX8)
requirements.existing_implementation: Existing navigation and evidence controls have no mission cue target contract.
requirements.required_change: Add stable target IDs and one cue presenter; cue is advisory, never a completion event.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Cue cannot substitute for evidence inspection.
requirements.test_requirement: One visible cue maximum; keyboard dismissal; no forced click order.

requirements.requirement: Proof Card: established, supporting refs, unknowns and why; no gamification (TUX7)
requirements.existing_implementation: Change Workspace exposes evidence, support receipts, SourceSpan, alignments and limitations but no tutorial proof receipt.
requirements.required_change: Render backend Proof with immutable source/receipt refs and RemainingUnknowns; no XP, confetti or fabricated overall PASS.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Proof is a tutorial evaluation receipt, not a canonical support receipt.
requirements.test_requirement: Backend proof-ref validation and frontend unknown/limitations visibility.

requirements.requirement: Authority/truth/resolution/coverage/execution modality remain separate (TUX2/TUX4)
requirements.existing_implementation: Evidence Inspector exposes all five dimensions and support receipt provenance; truth domain types already separate them.
requirements.required_change: Mission summaries may focus a dimension but must retain links and labels for all five.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Never reduce dimensions to a single confidence/PASS.
requirements.test_requirement: Contract tests for partial/unknown and five-dimension UI labels.

requirements.requirement: Design/Static/Runtime remain independent, with interpretation below (TUX5/TUX6)
requirements.existing_implementation: Backend derives each layer independently; Change Workspace currently renders them mainly as dense prose in one row.
requirements.required_change: Present three labeled columns from the existing alignment projection, followed by the existing derived interpretation; no new resolver.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Runtime OBSERVED never rewrites Static UNKNOWN/PRESENT; NOT_OBSERVED never means never executed.
requirements.test_requirement: W1/W2/W4 rendering and cross-layer contradiction tests.

requirements.requirement: Mission A uses frozen real W1 EXPECTED/PRESENT/OBSERVED and supports free-path evidence/source inspection (TUX9)
requirements.existing_implementation: Historical real W1 source, binary, trace, SQLite graph and bound receipts exist in the source workspace, but are absent from the 354-file public release.
requirements.required_change: Ship or reproducibly construct a checksum-verified, source/binary/build/revision-bound W1 tutorial witness in an isolated tutorial datastore; preserve genuine admission and SourceSpan refs.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Do not import a trace detached from its exact canonical and binary identity; no fake tutorial evidence.
requirements.test_requirement: Recreate W1 through public install; verify backend alignment, admissible support, exact source and proof refs.

requirements.requirement: Mission B uses real W2 EXPECTED/PRESENT/NOT_OBSERVED and W4 EXPECTED/UNKNOWN/OBSERVED (TUX5/TUX6/TUX9)
requirements.existing_implementation: Real bounded W2 and W4 witnesses and backend alignment tests exist in the original workspace, not the public release artifact.
requirements.required_change: Package/reconstruct W2 and W4 under the same exact witness identity contract; require an explicit safe-conclusion answer for each.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: W2 negative is bounded to workload/window; W4 static UNKNOWN must remain UNKNOWN.
requirements.test_requirement: W2 incomplete/mismatched coverage becomes UNMEASURED; W4 runtime does not promote static; invalid MISSING attempt explains missing COMPLETE static certificate.

requirements.requirement: Static MISSING only from applicable COMPLETE coverage; UNKNOWN != FALSE (TUX6)
requirements.existing_implementation: derive_static requires published support for PRESENT and applicable_complete exact-domain certificate for MISSING.
requirements.required_change: MissionEvaluator reads existing static state and certificate reason; invalid-conclusion response explains PARTIAL/UNKNOWN without mutating it.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: No tutorial-defined negative authority.
requirements.test_requirement: Reject MISSING on W4 and on absent/mismatched COMPLETE certificate.

requirements.requirement: Backend-only goal-based Mission evaluation; UI clicks never complete (TUX3/TUX18)
requirements.existing_implementation: Existing workbench reads backend projections, but there is no MissionSpec, MissionEvaluator or mission API.
requirements.required_change: Add thin MissionSpec/Evaluator and versioned API; evaluator re-queries bound backend evidence/receipts and checks a structured user conclusion plus server-issued inspection receipts.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Client-sent truth, click order, localStorage or unbound refs cannot satisfy a SuccessPredicate.
requirements.test_requirement: Forged clicks/ref IDs, stale revision, mismatched session and wrong conclusion fail closed; valid alternate navigation paths pass.

requirements.requirement: TutorialProgress and GUIDED/ASSISTED/INDEPENDENT are UX-only, reversible (TUX8/TUX11)
requirements.existing_implementation: No tutorial progress persistence exists; workbench local UI state is not evidence authority.
requirements.required_change: Persist namespaced tutorial session/progress apart from canonical/design/evidence tables; INDEPENDENT requires a separate transfer witness, not hint exhaustion.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Progress never becomes EvidenceCandidate, DesignRevision or authority receipt.
requirements.test_requirement: Isolation and reset tests; canonical current/revision/support receipt counts unchanged by progress changes.

requirements.requirement: Mission C uses isolated Tutorial Workspace + real tutorial Git worktree + bounded datastore (TUX10)
requirements.existing_implementation: GitWorkspaceManager creates scoped worktrees from a registered Git repo; Rintel_DATA_HOME isolates a datastore but no tutorial-owned workspace provisioning exists.
requirements.required_change: Provision a tutorial-owned source repo/worktree, datastore, artifact roots and allowlisted paths under a dedicated namespace; bind every Change/profile/job to that repo; cleanup only tutorial-owned paths.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Never point tutorial writes, worktree creation, index or build profiles at a user/production repo or datastore.
requirements.test_requirement: Sentinel hashes of production repo/datastore before/after, symlink/path traversal and cross-session isolation negatives.

requirements.requirement: Mission C real DesignChange, implementation, reindex, Expected-vs-Actual, LVS/alignment
requirements.existing_implementation: DesignLifecycleService and Change Workspace expose command-driven plan/reindex/evaluate/verify; existing backend computes alignment and LVS.
requirements.required_change: Mission C orchestrator calls the existing service against tutorial repo only; do not add TutorialTruthService or TutorialAlignmentService.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: A tutorial completion event cannot call canonical publication; only actual isolated reindex job may update isolated CURRENT.
requirements.test_requirement: Real bounded change produces linked index job, fresh comparison and same DesignRevision binding; prod CURRENT unchanged.

requirements.requirement: Mission C real Build, trusted Test and VERIFIED_REPAIR
requirements.existing_implementation: Server-owned ExecutionAuthority issues BUILD/TEST receipts; BuildRecovery assess_repair returns VERIFIED_REPAIR only after matching source/test/revision and lifecycle verify.
requirements.required_change: Register server-owned bounded tutorial BUILD/TEST profiles for the isolated worktree and expose existing receipt chain; no browser-supplied shell command.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Build PASS alone and Agent claim are not verified repair; use actual trusted TestRunReceipt and Change VERIFIED state.
requirements.test_requirement: BUILD fail→repair→BUILD pass→TEST fail/pass→reindex→verify; wrong source/revision/profile rejects.

requirements.requirement: Mission C excludes production approval/publication; stop at isolated VERIFIED_REPAIR
requirements.existing_implementation: Local owner and publication routes exist, but named authority line remains unclosed; isolated verified repair has a real historical witness.
requirements.required_change: Do not include approve/close/merge-to-production as Mission C success predicate or tutorial action.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: LOCAL_OWNER_AUTH0, APPROVAL-ISSUANCE-ANCHOR0 and COMMAND-GATE-CLOSURE0 are not claimed closed.
requirements.test_requirement: Mission C API rejects production repo/approval/close and tutorial completion leaves production CURRENT untouched.

requirements.requirement: Exact Evidence→SourceSpan→focused source, then surrounding/full source (TUX16)
requirements.existing_implementation: Change Workspace has bound source resolver and Evidence Inspector; workbench has SourceViewer and source dock.
requirements.required_change: Add mission inspection receipt only after successful server-bound evidence and SourceSpan read; preserve raw/full-source escape path.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: A client-reported click is not an inspection receipt; fallback fuzzy source jump is forbidden for proof.
requirements.test_requirement: Exact ref/revision/source-digest positives; forged/stale span negatives; full-source route remains available.

requirements.requirement: Build diagnostics preserve Normalized, Source, Evidence and Raw drilldown
requirements.existing_implementation: Change Workspace exposes build failure, bound diagnostic source and raw artifact APIs.
requirements.required_change: Mission cue/proof deep-links to existing diagnostic views without omitting raw provenance.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Normalized inference is not compiler observation.
requirements.test_requirement: Browser drilldown preserves diagnostic identity and raw access.

requirements.requirement: Real process stages for Index/Build/Test/Re-index/Verification; no spinner-only UI
requirements.existing_implementation: IndexProgress and Change Workspace reindex/activity/execution receipts exist; no unified tutorial-stage display.
requirements.required_change: Project stage labels from actual job and receipt states; unavailable stage remains UNAVAILABLE, not green.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Requested/running is not completed; do not infer success from elapsed time.
requirements.test_requirement: Pending/failure/cancel/stale-completed stage and refresh tests.

requirements.requirement: Independent transfer task before INDEPENDENT (TUX11)
requirements.existing_implementation: W1/W2/W4 provide core cases, not an independent transfer case.
requirements.required_change: Add a distinct, real, bounded evidence case with exact backend predicate; no recycled W1/W2/W4 answer key.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Assistance tier cannot certify understanding without transfer evidence.
requirements.test_requirement: Fresh-user transfer acceptance and wrong/guessed answer negatives.

requirements.requirement: Keyboard-only completion and status not conveyed by color alone (TUX12/TUX13)
requirements.existing_implementation: Current views use native buttons and some aria labels; Mission controls do not exist.
requirements.required_change: Mission strip/drawer/cue/proof must use semantic text, focus order, escape and screen-reader labels.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Visual emphasis must not alter evidence state.
requirements.test_requirement: Keyboard-only A/B/C and accessible-name/status assertions at all audited widths.

requirements.requirement: Progressive disclosure keeps topology, raw evidence and full Inspector discoverable (TUX15/TUX16)
requirements.existing_implementation: Topology route, Inspector, bound source and raw build artifacts are already reachable.
requirements.required_change: Focus initial mission on Overview/Alignment/Evidence without locking advanced routes or hiding raw evidence.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: No redacted or filtered evidence presented as complete.
requirements.test_requirement: Navigation and raw evidence remain reachable during active mission.

requirements.requirement: Mission D advanced multi-Agent/Git is not first-run onboarding
requirements.existing_implementation: GitWorkspaceManager and collaboration APIs exist with real worktree provenance.
requirements.required_change: Do not implement Mission D in A/B/C release; retain Agent commit != accepted truth and merge != CURRENT in explanatory contract.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Git merge cannot be treated as canonical publication.
requirements.test_requirement: No Mission D completion endpoint in first-run API; Git semantics regression.

requirements.requirement: Real browser E2E and zero critical truth-boundary teaching errors (TUX17/TUX18)
requirements.existing_implementation: Historical backend witness tests and web E2E suites exist only in unreleased source workspace; public source release tracks no tests.
requirements.required_change: Bring focused test contracts into the public branch and add real installed-browser A/B/C journey plus fresh-user transfer; never use UI-only fixture as truth.
requirements.truth_authority_risk: Test absence in v0.1.0 cannot be relabeled PASS; explicit semantic errors are release blockers.
requirements.test_requirement: Backend predicate/isolation/authority tests, web unit/typecheck/build, 1280/1440/1800 browser journey and fresh-user zero-critical-error review.
